section.p: Consider a Markdown topic that contains a numbered list describing a sequence of actions that the user must perform to create a new alarm notification.

table.title: Consecutive numbered list is a procedure

entry.codeblock: # Creating a New Alarm Notification To create a new alarm notification: 1. Click **Alarms**. 2. Click **Add Notification**. 3. Configure the notification settings. 4. Click **Save**.

Creating a New Alarm Notification

To create a new alarm notification:

 Click Alarms. Click Add Notification. Configure the notification settings. Click Save.

section.p: Result: The converter recognizes that the numbered list represents a procedure and converts the topic into a DITA task topic. Each numbered list item becomes a DITA <step> element, and the list is converted into a <steps> structure.
